trust.title: How we keep reviews and information honest
trust.description: Every review and every fact on EduMaps.kg goes through the same checks, for every school. A person reads each review before it appears.
publishedItems: Written by a registered member about their own experience with the school
Read by a person before it appears. Nothing is published automatically
Honest criticism is welcome when it is polite and sticks to facts
One review per person per school; you can update it later
rejectedItems: Insults, hate speech, threats or personal attacks
Accusations without evidence, and private details of children or staff
Reviews written to harm a competing school, or by someone who owns or runs the school
Copied or repeated texts and organised campaigns, whether they praise or attack
Spam, advertising, links, and paid or exchanged reviews
trust.ratingNote: A school's score is calculated only from reviews that passed these checks. Advertising and payments never change a score or a position.
infoItems: Only the EduMaps.kg team enters and changes school details. Schools cannot edit their own page, buy a better one, or have reviews removed
Profiles we have not confirmed with the school are clearly marked “Unverified” or “Demo”. When a fact is unconfirmed we write “Information pending” instead of guessing
Anyone, including the school itself, can report a mistake. We check the source before anything changes
Advertisements are always labelled “Advertisement”, look different from school cards, and never change a score or a position
trust.report: Saw something wrong? Use “Report” under a review, or “Report incorrect information” on a school page.

about.title: About EduMaps.kg
about.intro: EduMaps.kg is an independent, neutral education discovery platform for Kyrgyzstan. We help parents make informed decisions about schools without having to visit dozens of campuses first.
about.lineText: Line.kg is an educational systems and technology company focused on improving educational access, transparency and quality across Central Asia.
about.operatedBy: EduMaps.kg is a project developed and operated by Line.kg
about.mission1: Discover schools in every major city of Kyrgyzstan, with photos, videos and detailed profiles.
about.mission2: Compare up to four schools side by side on tuition, languages, programs and facilities.
about.mission3: Read moderated reviews from real parents and students.
about.mission4: Learn about education systems and methodologies in the Education Hub.
about.principle1Text: Schools cannot buy a better rating or a higher position. Rankings use only moderated review data.
about.principle2Text: Advertisements are always labelled “Advertisement” and are kept separate from school information.
about.principle3Text: Reviews and community posts are read by a person and published only when they follow our rules.
about.principle4Text: Everything is available in Kyrgyz, Russian and English.
about.adsText: Language schools, summer camps, robotics centres, educational companies and event organisers can place clearly labelled ads. Advertising never changes ratings, rankings or search results.
about.contactText: For corrections, school listings or advertising enquiries, use the contact page or write to the Line.kg team directly.

forSchools.title: For schools
forSchools.intro: EduMaps.kg is an independent guide that helps parents choose a school. If your school has a page here, or you would like one, this is how it works.
includes: Address, contact details, school hours and a map link.
Tuition and what it covers, languages of instruction, programmes and facilities.
Photos and a video from the school.
Reviews from parents and students, published only after moderation.
forSchools.freeText: A basic listing costs nothing. If your school would like to show more photos or videos than the basic listing allows, write to us.
forSchools.fairTitle: The same rules for every school
fair: Schools cannot buy a better grade or a higher position. Grades come only from moderated reviews.
Advertisements are always labelled and kept apart from school information.
Only our team edits school pages. Schools do not have accounts, so no school can change its own page or another school’s page.
Until a school’s details are confirmed, its page says so.
forSchools.fixText: You know your school best. Tell us what is wrong or missing, and we will check it before we change the page.
fixSteps: Open your school’s page and press “Report incorrect information”, or write to us.
Choose “School staff” and leave a phone number or email, so we can confirm the message comes from the school.
We check the information and update the page. Messages from schools are marked so that our team verifies them first.
forSchools.photosText: Send photos that you own and are free to publish. Do not send photos of children unless their parents have agreed. Videos are shown from YouTube links, so the school keeps control of them.
forSchools.removeTitle: Would you rather not be listed?
forSchools.removeText: Write to us and we will remove your school’s page.
forSchools.contactText: Write to us by email or WhatsApp, or use the contact form.
